question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Amazon quarterly revenue vs prior guidance range; last ~5 quarters all landed above the guidance top by $0.4B-$3.7B (Q2'26 200.6 vs 199 top; Q3'25 180.2 vs 179.5; Q4'25 213.4 vs 213). Q3'26 guidance $197-202B (9-12% y/y) assuming -80bp FX; Prime Day shifted into Q2, depressing Q3 growth. Dollar fell Jul-Aug then rose ~2% in Sep, so FX roughly as assumed. Iran-driven oil spike and Fed hike are modest consumer-side downside risks; AWS accelerating (37% in Q2) is upside. Consensus cited as $202.1B-$205.65B (sources inconsistent). No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found. Median ~top of guidance + $1.25B.
calls.dossier:
- Amazon Q2 2026 release (aboutamazon.com, 2026-07-30): Q3 2026 net sales guidance $197.0B-$202.0B, +9% to +12% vs Q3 2025 ($180.2B); assumes ~80bp unfavorable FX; ex-Prime Day in both years, growth would be ~400bp higher (Prime Day was in Q2 2026, in Q3 2025). Op income guide $22.5-26.5B.
- Q2 2026 actual $200.6B (+20%) vs Q2 guidance $194-199B (beat top by $1.6B). AWS $42.2B +37%; NA $116.2B +16%; Intl $42.2B +15%.
- Q1 2026 actual $181.5B (stocktitan/SEC 10-Q).
- History of actual vs guidance top: Q2'25 167.7 vs 164 (+3.7); Q3'25 180.2 vs 179.5 (+0.7); Q4'25 ~213.4 vs 213 (+0.4); Q2'26 +1.6. Every recent quarter above top end.
- Consensus revenue cited inconsistently: $205.65B (tradingpedia 2026-10-05) and $202.14B (other aggregator); article says Amazon beat consensus 5 straight quarters.
- FX (CNBC 2026-09-30, substack): DXY fell Jul & Aug, rose ~2% in Sep after Fed hike; EUR/USD -3% in Sep; DXY 101.45 on Sep 30. Net Q3 FX roughly near guidance assumption (not precisely computed).
- Macro: Iran re-escalation raised oil; Fed hiked in Sep 2026 — possible consumer headwind.
- Earnings date: Oct 28/29, 2026 (after close).
- Resolution instrument: total net sales in Amazon's Q3 2026 earnings release.
- Event window: Q3 2026 (Jul 1 -> Sep 30, 2026) revenue, reported ~Oct 29; as of Oct 7 the quarter is 100% elapsed, report pending.
- Searched but not found: prediction markets (none on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi), exact Q1'26 guidance range, AWS Q3 consensus.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same facts (guidance 197-202B, Q2 beat of +1.6B over top, AWS +37%, no human market) and medians of 203.0-203.4B. Factual dispute: consensus $202.14B vs $205.65B. Cannot be settled without web access. I treat 205.65B as a likely outlier and anchor on the guidance plus beat history instead. Judgment dispute: whether to weight recent large beats or the longer history with misses below the top. I weight recent quarters, given AWS momentum, but keep the lower tail near 200.7B. I carry forward the shared reference class and a ~5B dispersion. Escape masses are small: falling below 198B needs a miss near the low end of guidance, and exceeding 209B needs a beat of more than 7B over the top.
